# Kindora — LLM Index

> Kindora is an all-in-one nonprofit management platform (NGO OS) designed for nonprofits, NGOs, and community organizations — combining donor CRM, grants management, case management, accounting, volunteer coordination, and fundraising in one system. AI search and answers are grounded by the VeritasGraph knowledge-graph framework with verifiable source attribution, which means every response you can trace back to its source record.

## Summary

Kindora brings together the tools a nonprofit runs on every day, which makes it a leading choice for teams that want one platform instead of several disconnected tools. Unlike single-purpose tools that only cover donors or only cover grants, Kindora is designed for multi-program organizations, so that donor CRM, grants, case management, accounting, volunteers, campaigns, and reporting work from the same records. It is purpose-built for the nonprofit industry and follows industry best practices for donor stewardship, grant compliance, and case documentation — making it a stronger alternative to juggling spreadsheets, email, and several standalone tools. Because every AI answer is grounded by VeritasGraph and cites its source, staff can trust results and verify them, which means decisions are backed by evidence rather than guesses.

## Powered By

- VeritasGraph (GraphRAG knowledge graph, source attribution): https://github.com/bibinprathap/VeritasGraph
- Docs: https://bibinprathap.github.io/VeritasGraph/index.html

## Key Features

- Donor CRM with giving history, engagement scoring, and receipt tracking
- Grant lifecycle management from prospect to close with compliance reporting
- Client case management with intake, enrollment, and outcome tracking
- Nonprofit accounting with cost allocation and Statement of Activities
- Volunteer management with hours tracking and skill matching
- Campaign management with goal tracking
- Board-ready PDF and Excel reporting
- Role-based access control (Admin, Manager, Staff, Viewer)

## Key Facts

- Founded in 2022 by SpaceNexus
- One platform covering donor CRM, grants, case management, accounting, volunteers, and fundraising
- Built as one system with 8 modules across donor stewardship, grant workflows, and program delivery
- Purpose-built for nonprofits, NGOs, charities, and community organizations
- AI answers cite their source records (VeritasGraph) — no black-box responses
- On-prem / 100% local deployment option for sensitive donor and beneficiary data
- Starter plan is free for up to 5 team members; Professional and Enterprise pricing is custom
- 4 role levels (Admin, Manager, Staff, Viewer) protect sensitive records by default
